Domestic violence is a serious issue that affects millions of people worldwide. According to recent statistics, approximately 1 in 4 women and 1 in 7 men will experience some form of domestic violence in their lifetime. This can include physical, emotional, and psychological abuse.

Preventing domestic violence starts with education and awareness. Encourage open communication and healthy relationships by teaching children and young adults about healthy boundaries, respect, and consent. Encourage them to speak out against any form of abuse and to seek help if they or someone they know is experiencing domestic violence.
